# Quicken Community

> > A peer-to-peer support community where Quicken users help each other troubleshoot banking, investments, and personal finance management across Windows and Mac platforms.

Quicken Community is an active user forum covering all aspects of Quicken personal finance software, including account management, transaction downloads, online banking, investments, and reporting. The community is moderated by Quicken support staff and features curated best discussions highlighting common issues and feature requests.

## Key Topics

- Online Banking
- Account Management
- Transaction Downloads
- Investments
- Reconciliation
- Bill Payments
- Windows Support
- Mac Support
- Known Issues
- Troubleshooting
- Categories & Budgeting
- Reports & Dashboard
- Community Forums
- Feature Requests
- Customer Support

## Community Hub

- [Quicken Community](https://community.quicken.com/discussions): Main Quicken Community forum for resources and help from users and support team
- [Community Categories](https://community.quicken.com/categories): Community categories hub organizing discussions by topic and product
- [Unanswered Questions](https://community.quicken.com/discussions/unanswered): Unanswered Quicken support questions across all products and platforms
- [Best Of Community](https://community.quicken.com/bestof): Curated best community discussions highlighting feature requests and bug reports

## Banking & Accounts

- [Online Banking](https://community.quicken.com/discussions/tagged/online-banking): Community discussions on Quicken online banking setup and connection issues
- [Accounts](https://community.quicken.com/discussions/tagged/accounts): Community discussions on Quicken account linking and management
- [Download Transactions](https://community.quicken.com/discussions/tagged/download-transactions): Community discussions on transaction downloads and sync troubleshooting
- [Bill Payments](https://community.quicken.com/discussions/tagged/bill-payments): Community discussions on Quicken bill payment setup and troubleshooting
- [Reconcile](https://community.quicken.com/discussions/tagged/Reconcile): Community discussions on account reconciliation and balance verification

## Transactions & Organization

- [Add/Edit Transactions](https://community.quicken.com/discussions/tagged/add-edit-transactions): Community discussions on transaction management and categorization in Quicken
- [Categories](https://community.quicken.com/discussions/tagged/categories): Community discussions on transaction categorization and budgeting setup

## Investments & Reporting

- [Investments](https://community.quicken.com/discussions/tagged/Investments): Community discussions on Quicken investment account management and sync
- [Reports](https://community.quicken.com/discussions/tagged/reports): Community discussions on Quicken reports, dashboards, and portfolio features

## Platform Support

- [Windows](https://community.quicken.com/discussions/tagged/Windows): Community discussions for Quicken Windows troubleshooting and account issues
- [Mac](https://community.quicken.com/discussions/tagged/Mac): Community discussions for Mac platform Quicken support and troubleshooting
- [Quicken Mac](https://community.quicken.com/discussions/tagged/quicken-mac): Community discussions specific to Quicken Mac banking and account issues

## Troubleshooting & Issues

- [Known Issues](https://community.quicken.com/discussions/tagged/known-issues): Community discussions documenting known Quicken bugs and issues

## Optional

- [What's Your Go-To Feel-Good Song?](https://community.quicken.com/discussion/7971619/what-s-your-go-to-feel-good-song/p1): Off-topic community discussion thread about music preferences
